theorem lg_target (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x = 3 * x + 2) : Function.Injective f := by
  intro x y
  rw [hf x, hf y]
  assume h : 3 * x + 2 = 3 * y + 2
  rw [sub_eq_zero] at h
  have h1 : 3 * (x - y) = 0 := h
  rw [mul_eq_zero] at h1
  cases h1 with h2 h3
  · rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  · rw [h3] at h1
    exact h1
